xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-1525: Harness-independent composer commands: canonical manifest, /pan router, and cross-harness parity

plan.title: Harness-independent composer commands: canonical manifest, /pan router, and cross-harness parity
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: The dashboard composer's command surface is harness-dependent: typing /pan start PAN-X in a Codex-backed conversation is rejected by Codex's own slash namespace and never reaches Overdeck. Discovery (PAN-3021's generated autocomplete) exists, but there is no /pan router, no execution modes, no safety classes, no structured command results, and no harness-native command modeling. Isolated Codex homes also lack synced skills.
narratives.Proposal: Extend PAN-3021's build-time introspection with options/aliases and emit one canonical manifest into @overdeck/contracts, shared by server and frontend and drift-gated by lint. Intercept /pan server-side in both the conversation and agent message handlers before compact/attachments/delivery, validate against the manifest plus a hand-written policy overlay (captured/detached/ui/terminal-only x safe/dialog/destructive, fail-closed to terminal-only), execute via spawnPanCli argv subprocesses (bounded capture, activity-tracked detached), enforce nonce-based confirmations, return a typed ComposerCommandResult the composer renders as a system timeline entry, model harness-native commands as per-harness capability data, seed isolated Codex homes with synced skills, and prove it all with a no-loss audit plus a four-harness interception matrix (claude-code, codex, ohmypi, acp).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Executing administrative/destructive CLI commands from the composer beyond the bounded first set (start, plan, show, status, tell, handoff/fork); everything else stays terminal-only
- Replacing the terminal CLI or dashboard action menus
- Normalizing native Claude/Codex/ohmypi/acp command syntax into one model
- Routing /pan through the model as a prompt
- Copying the whole ~/.codex directory into isolated homes
- Live external-value autocomplete beyond existing local data
- Refactoring src/cli/index.ts into an import-safe builder (superseded by adopting PAN-3021's in-process introspection)

autoDecisions.summary: Adopted PAN-3021's landed shape (in-process introspection + committed generated module) and retired the PRD's original WI-1 import-safe builder and NFR-6.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's 2026-07-24 revision note mandates adopting PAN-3021's landed artifacts; its shape avoids importing the argv-parsing CLI entrypoint into the dashboard bundle entirely.

autoDecisions.summary: Emit the canonical manifest into @overdeck/contracts so server and frontend share one generated source, with a documented two-sibling-modules fallback if build order forces it.
autoDecisions.rationale: Single-source-of-truth tenet; contracts is the existing shared workspace both sides already import. The fallback is pinned as an implementation checkpoint so no judgment call is needed downstream.

autoDecisions.summary: Overdeck autocomplete entries switch insertion from unprefixed 'pan <path>' to '/pan <path> ', with an explicit old-to-new mapping in the no-loss audit.
autoDecisions.rationale: The deterministic control-plane form is the product of this issue; keeping the menu inserting prompt-lane text would contradict FR-1/FR-2. The audit's deliberate-change mechanism preserves no-loss guarantees.

autoDecisions.summary: Execution spawns the bundled CLI via existing spawnPanCli argv arrays; only the detached+activity pattern is extracted downward into src/lib.
autoDecisions.rationale: spawnPanCli (src/lib/pan-cli-invocation.ts) already provides shell-free argv spawning through the CLI write door, satisfying NFR-1/NFR-2 without new abstractions.

autoDecisions.summary: Added acp to the parity matrix as FR-14 alongside claude-code, codex, and ohmypi.
autoDecisions.rationale: The acp harness landed after the PRD was written; server-side interception precedes delivery so coverage is nearly free, and omitting the fourth harness would silently narrow the issue's harness-independence claim.

autoDecisions.summary: Kept the ComposerFooter handoff regex fast-path and added server-side ui-result parity instead of removing the fast-path.
autoDecisions.rationale: Preserves current zero-latency UX (no-loss) while D4 still makes the server the enforcement boundary for retries and non-dashboard clients.

autoDecisions.summary: Confirmations follow the settings.ts reindex-nonce precedent (single-use, expiring, argv-bound) rather than the generic /api/confirmations endpoints.
autoDecisions.rationale: Command confirmation must bind nonce to target + canonical argv + safety class, which the reindex pattern already demonstrates in-process.

Parse and validate /pan input against the manifest

expected_outputs: parser suite passes covering accept and reject tables
typecheck completes without errors

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/composer-commands/parser.ts: parseOverdeckComposerCommand(message) returns null for any text not starting with '/pan' followed by whitespace or end (so /pan-handoff stays a distinct alias handled by the router). For /pan input it tokenizes (double/single-quoted values, --flag value and --flag=value), resolves the longest matching command path (including aliases) from COMPOSER_COMMAND_MANIFEST, validates required positionals and known flags, and returns { entry, argv } with canonical argv (path tokens + positionals + flags). Errors are typed: unknown-command, missing-argument, unknown-flag, forbidden-token. Reject shell metacharacters (; | & < > ` $( )) anywhere in the input with forbidden-token. Never invoke a shell and never call Commander's parse (no process side effects).

items.title: '/pan start PAN-42' returns entry path ['start'] and argv ['start','PAN-42']; quoted and --flag=value forms produce the same canonical argv as their unquoted/spaced equivalents
The parser returns typed errors naming the offending token and the expected syntax for unknown commands, missing required positionals, and unknown flags
The parser rejects input containing shell metacharacters with forbidden-token and spawns no child process
The parser returns null for ordinary text, unprefixed 'pan start', and '/model' — none are treated as Overdeck commands

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/composer-commands/router.ts exposing handleComposerCommand({ parsed, target }) which resolves policy and returns a ComposerCommandResult (executors land in later items — until then captured/detached/ui policies may return a typed not-yet-registered terminal-only result, kept internal to this branch). In handleConversationMessage (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-message.ts), immediately after the presence/length validation (lines 400-404) and BEFORE the manual-compact interception (line 406), call parseOverdeckComposerCommand(message); when non-null, return the router's result as the HTTP response and skip compact, attachment extraction, transformMessageForHarness, memory injection, and delivery entirely. Parser errors map to 400/404/422 responses with the typed error and expected syntax in complete sentences. Non-/pan messages must flow through the existing path byte-identically. Reconcile the file-size baseline. This item pins the router API shape all later items build on.

Captured executors for show, status, and tell

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/composer-commands/executors.ts. runCapturedCommand(argv) spawns via spawnPanCli (src/lib/pan-cli-invocation.ts) with an argv array, collects stdout+stderr up to 65536 bytes (then sets truncated: true and stops buffering), applies a 30s timeout that kills the child, and returns { kind: 'captured', status: 'completed' | 'failed', command, output, truncated } where status reflects the exit code and failure output includes stderr. Wire captured policies (show, status, tell) through the router. No shell, no execSync, no env mutation beyond what spawnPanCli does. Timeout tests use Vitest fake timers.

items.title: '/pan status' spawns the bundled CLI with argv ['status'] (no shell) and returns kind captured with the process output and exit-code-derived status
Output beyond 64 KiB returns truncated: true with the bounded prefix; the response states truncation in a complete sentence

Nonce-based dialog and typed-destructive confirmation enforcement

expected_outputs: confirmation suite passes: single-use, expiry via fake timers, argv binding, typed-text mismatch rejection
typecheck completes without errors

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/composer-commands/confirmations.ts following the settings.ts reindex-nonce precedent (src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts:58-86): randomBytes(24).toString('base64url') nonces in an in-process Map, single-use, 5-minute expiry, each bound to { target (conversation/agent id), canonical argv, safety class }. Router flow: a dialog/destructive command without a valid nonce returns { kind: 'confirmation', status: 'confirmation_required', nonce, consequence, typedText? }; resubmission with the nonce (and, for destructive, the exact typed text from policy) executes; missing, expired, replayed, or argv-mismatched confirmation returns 422 and executes nothing. Since D6 registers no destructive command, add a test-only synthetic destructive policy entry (guarded so it never appears in production discovery) proving the typed path end-to-end. All expiry tests use vi.useFakeTimers() + advanceTimersByTimeAsync — never real waits.

items.title: A dialog command first returns confirmation_required with consequence text in complete sentences; resubmitting with the issued nonce executes exactly once
A nonce replayed, expired (advanced past TTL with fake timers), or presented with different argv returns 422 and spawns nothing
The synthetic destructive command executes only when the exact typed confirmation text accompanies a valid nonce; any other text is rejected

Move the current global STATIC_SLASH_COMMANDS AI-CLI entries (/model, /context, /effort, /cancel) into the claude-code list if verified there (and any other harness where verified); remove them from the global static list, leaving /handoff dashboard-owned. The composer builds its '<Harness> native' menu group from the active conversation's behavior.nativeCommands.

Data comes from static imports of @overdeck/contracts and the policy module — no per-request rebuild, no CLI import, no spawn. An invalid harness value returns 400 naming the accepted values. Follow PRD implementation checkpoint 4: this route lands with a throwaway built-server boot test before any live restart.

Render structured command results in the composer timeline

verify_commands: cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/composerStore.test.ts
expected_outputs: composerStore suite passes covering result rendering and outbox kind preservation
lint including file-size ratchet exits 0

narrative.Action: In composerStore.ts (POST sites at lines 105-117), detect when the response body is a ComposerCommandResult (import the union from @overdeck/contracts). For command results: do not add an optimistic agent-message bubble; render a system-style timeline entry showing the command, its status (accepted/completed/failed/rejected/confirmation_required) in complete sentences, captured output (monospace, truncation notice when truncated: true), and the activity id for detached results. confirmation_required renders a confirm affordance that resubmits with the nonce. Retry outbox entries (failSend line 251, retryFailed lines 441-453) gain a kind field ('command' | 'prompt') so a retried /pan command resubmits through the same endpoint as a command and can never be replayed as a prompt. Ordinary prompt flow, attachments, and optimistic bubbles stay byte-identical (negative-control test).

items.title: Submitting '/pan status' renders a system-style timeline entry with the captured output and no optimistic agent-message bubble; the transcript shows no /pan text as an agent message
A detached result renders the accepted sentence with its activity id; a failed result renders the actionable error text from the server
A failed /pan send persists in the outbox with kind 'command' and its retry sends it as a command, never as a prompt (test asserts the retried POST branch)

No-loss audit and four-harness interception matrix

narrative.Action: Two suites. (1) composerCommands.no-loss.test.ts freezes the complete pre-change inventory — the 5 static entries, the 255 generated inserts, and the three handoff aliases — and asserts each maps to a generated Overdeck manifest entry, a harness-native capability, a preserved alias, or an explicit exclusion row with a reason; an unmapped disappearance fails. (2) harness-matrix.test.ts drives handleConversationMessage (and the agent endpoint handler) table-driven across harness values claude-code, codex, ohmypi, and acp with '/pan start PAN-999': each row asserts the identical canonical argv and result shape and that deliverConversationViaControlChannel, deliverAgentMessage, and FIFO/sendMessage primitives are never invoked (spies). Negative controls per harness: ordinary text and unprefixed 'pan start PAN-999' still invoke that harness's delivery primitive exactly as today.
